messages:
maggie: hey all, first-week q. got my company MBP (Intel -> handed down) and the MDM enrollment profile installed but the console says 'Device pending OS update support' and FileVault enable button is greyed out. macOS is 11.6.8. anyone seen this?

it-support: welcome! :wave: sometimes our MDM requires a min OS (12.5+) for automated FDE flows. Did you get a prompt to install a bridge package?

maggie: i saw 'install system extension' and a little installer popup earlier but cancelled it because I wasn't sure.

it-support: ok. that bridge is our compatibility helper for older macOS. We can either schedule an OS update to Monterey/13.x, or install the bridge which will allow escrow without full OS upgrade. Which do you prefer?

maggie: i'd rather avoid full upgrade this morning. bridge sounds fine.

it-security-bot: Security policy: approved bridge installers must be delivered via MDM. Manual installs are blocked by policy.

it-support: we'll push the bridge now and open a screen share so you can approve the system extension. Please go to System Preferences -> Security & Privacy -> General after we send it.

(remy joins screen)
it-support: pushing package... done. You should see a banner in Security & Privacy. Click "Allow" and then restart when prompted.

maggie: clicked Allow. restart now?

it-support: yes please. After reboot, check `sudo fdesetup status` and the console.

(maggie reboots)
maggie: back up. `sudo fdesetup status` shows FileVault is Off but the web console now shows 'Ready for escrow'. I clicked enable FDE in prefs and it prompted for my password, got a long key and mdm bot posted success.

it-support: sweet. enrollment complete and device compliant. follow-up: we'll schedule an optional full OS upgrade next week during a maintenance window.

maggie: thanks everyone! saved my morning :heart:
